payload.reason: The evidence describes the use of a binary classifier in the context of identifying relevant text segments from scientific documents.

claims.text: A binary classifier is used to identify publications that meet specific criteria based on relevant text segments.
The binary classifier is trained on candidate sentences, which improves its performance compared to training on randomly selected sentences.
The classifier utilized in the study is a Bernoulli Naïve Bayes classifier, trained on binary occurrence matrices derived from n-grams.
